repair_summary: Damage: line-range seds rewrote textdistance/algorithms/compression_based.py (a global call counter adds drifting noise to _NCDBase._get_size, __call__ sometimes drops permutations, RLENCD/SqrtNCD/EntropyNCD sizes get checksum offsets). The seds also clobbered neighbouring code (_NCDBase._compress, _BinaryNCDBase, RLENCD._compress, EntropyNCD return/_get_size, LZMANCD), so the module no longer imports. Separately, stdlib bz2.py compress() now injects a data-dependent byte. Repair: restore bz2.py from the pristine python-3.10.18 copy still in /opt/miniconda3/pkgs, with an inline-patch fallback. Rewrite compression_based.py as upstream textdistance 4.6.3, keeping every intact part and reconstructing the clobbered classes from upstream source. The whole test suite then passes (430/430), including the per-compressor tests that check exact values.
